name: CRM - Customer Health Dashboard
description: Theo dõi sức khỏe khách hàng: satisfaction score, churn risk, retention rate

native.query: SELECT ROUND(AVG(score), 2) as avg_score FROM crm_satisfaction_surveys WHERE tenant_id = {{tenant_id}} AND submitted_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'

SELECT c.name, c.email, MAX(s.submitted_at) as last_survey, AVG(s.score) as avg_score FROM crm_customers c JOIN crm_satisfaction_surveys s ON c.id = s.customer_id WHERE c.tenant_id = {{tenant_id}} GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.email HAVING AVG(s.score) < 3 ORDER BY avg_score ASC LIMIT 15

SELECT date_trunc('week', created_at) as week, status, COUNT(*) as count FROM crm_tickets WHERE tenant_id = {{tenant_id}} AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days' GROUP BY week, status ORDER BY week
